scope: Isolated GoTrue, PostgREST and application RPCs; selected requirements, not ASVS level certification

required.condition: Real password login identifies the linked employee; protected RPC returns the owner's synthetic marker
Anonymous requests cannot read sheets or invoke administrative RPCs
Tampered, unsigned, expired and not-yet-valid tokens are rejected by PostgREST
An authenticated but unlinked Auth user cannot read sheets or invoke administrative RPCs
Another employee's real token cannot read, edit or transition the owner's sheet; stored data remains unchanged
Employee and Reviewer cannot change roles, issue invitations or execute privileged sheet operations
A valid goal edit mixed with a forbidden score is rejected atomically; normal owner edits still work
Suspension removes access using the exact same previously accepted access token
The owner cannot skip goal approval or replay submission; state and notification counts obey the workflow
Neither Admin nor ordinary employees can read the SMTP password through PostgREST
Audit writes cannot be forged through the API; audit storage failure rolls back an Admin's privileged operation
Direct password-grant attempts from one source receive 429 within 80 attempts; no failed response contains a session and valid login recovers within 20 seconds; IP-only scope

The same pinned ZAP plan fails with an invalid token and succeeds with real authentication before/after scanning; all five active rules send requests, the scanner is not stopped, all AF tests succeed and there are no Medium or High alerts

pending.reason: Distributed password spraying, per-account controls and credential-stuffing detection are not covered by the single-source rate test
MFA enforcement and alternate authentication/recovery-path strength are not implemented as required gates
Token type, issuer and audience policy require a separate hosted-gateway contract
SMTP SSRF, hosted TLS/CORS, Tauri IPC, production Auth drift and endpoint-wide DAST coverage require separate verification
